description: This PHP source file defines the PerformanceReviewService class within the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It includes methods for managing performance reviews, such as activation, updating, and saving reviewer ratings. It interacts with DAOs, entities, and traits to encapsulate review business logic.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewService
classes.description: Service class for handling performance review operations such as activation, updates, and reviewer ratings management within the OrangeHRM plugin.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the PerformanceReviewDao instance used for database operations related to performance reviews.

methods.name: activateReview
methods.description: Activates a performance review, assigning it to a reviewer by employee number.

methods.name: updateActivateReview
methods.description: Updates an existing performance review after validating reviewer and employee status.

methods.name: activateReviewCommonExceptions
methods.description: Private helper method to validate the performance review before activation, checking for job title and KPI.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateReviewRatings
methods.description: Processes and saves or updates reviewer ratings for a performance review.

methods.name: createRatingsFromRows
methods.description: Constructs ReviewerRating objects from provided rating rows and associates them with the review and reviewer.

methods.name: generateReviewReviewerRatingKey
methods.description: Generates a string key for reviewer ratings based on reviewer ID, review ID, and KPI ID.
